findings_to_judge.finding: InnovAge's raised FY2026 guidance implies a Q4 adjusted EBITDA of only $14.7-19.7M (9M actual $70.3M = Q1 $17.6M + Q2 $22.2M + Q3 $30.495M, against a $85-90M full-year guide) and Q4 revenue of $222-247M versus Q3's $251.9M actual - i.e. a sequential revenue decline and a 4-5pp margin collapse - even though census rose to ~8,050, Colorado/state Medicaid rates are fixed through 30 June, Medicare risk scores are fixed for the calendar year, and the in-house pharmacy saving is structural; the identical structure in FY2025 (9M EBITDA $23.1M vs a $24-31M guide, implying Q4 of $0.9-7.9M) produced an actual Q4 of $11.3M and a full year of $34.5M, 11% above the top of guidance.

Colorado - InnovAge's home and largest state - enacted roughly $270M of Medicaid reimbursement cuts for FY2026-27, taking most fee-for-service rates down to 85% of Medicare from 2026-04-01 and layering a further 2.0% across-the-board reduction on HCBS waiver services for dates of service from 2026-07-01, published in the June 2026 provider bulletin after InnovAge last spoke to investors; PACE Medicaid capitation is set beneath an upper payment limit derived from exactly those FFS/HCBS costs, so the FY2027 Colorado rate InnovAge must build its first FY2027 guide around is flat-to-down rather than the mid-single-digit increases of prior years.

TCO Group Holdings (Apax and Welsh Carson) registered 112,988,070 shares - 83.2% of the 135,736,393 outstanding - for resale on a Form S-3 filed 2026-07-31 and declared effective 2026-08-05, routed there via a confidential draft registration statement submitted 2026-07-17, with no 8-K and no press release at any point; the company then scheduled FY2026 results for 2026-09-08 after the close and a Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference presentation at 08:00 ET on 2026-09-09, which is the standard sequencing for a marketed block in the window immediately after the print, and the shelf removes the Rule 144 affiliate volume cap of roughly 1.36M shares per quarter that has been the only constraint on the sponsors selling.
